verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DLSS documentation covers RTX 50 Series parts like the 5080. It lists DLSS Multi Frame Generation (up to five generated frames per rendered frame, using fifth-gen Tensor Cores), AI Super Resolution upscaling, DLAA and Ray Reconstruction. It also says the NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS models. TechPowerUp's review confirms the 5080 includes all the new RTX 50 features. Missing for 10: an explicit native game-support list or count for Multi Frame Generation, and independent hands-on testing of DLSS image quality and frame generation on the 5080 itself.
